caveats: Some Student-t confidence limits for bounded QoS metrics extend outside their physical range. Keep the unmodified values for reproducibility, but clip only the visual display or use bootstrap/binomial intervals in the thesis.

No comparison remains significant under exact Wilcoxon-Holm correction at alpha=0.05. The paired t-Holm results are significant, but with eight training seeds the paper must report both tests and avoid an unconditional significance claim.
AO-SCA achieves the highest sum-rate at every N; TD3 must not be presented as the best-quality method.
AnalyticalRIS is faster than TD3 but fails QoS in this experiment; TD3 must not be called the fastest absolute method.
AO-Grid and AnalyticalRIS are weak quality baselines here. A Q1 submission should justify their parameterization and add ablations or stronger learning baselines where possible.
